question: Which freedom fighter of India led the famous revolt of 1857 (sepoy mutiny) at Lucknow?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Begum Hazrat Mahal.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Point__:**

__
 
• **Begum Hazrat Mahal was one of the prominent leaders of the Indian Rebellion of 1857 and played a key role in the uprising against the British East India Company.**
 
• She was the wife of the then Lucknow ruler, Nawab Wajid Ali Shah, and was instrumental in organizing the rebels and leading the fight against the British forces.
 
• Begum Hazrat Mahal is remembered for her bravery, leadership, and her contribution to the Indian freedom struggle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Kasturba Gandhi** was the wife of Mahatma Gandhi and was actively involved in the Indian independence movement. However, she did not play a role in the 1857 revolt.
 
• **Alluri Sitarama Raju **was a tribal leader and freedom fighter from Andhra Pradesh who led a rebellion against the British Raj in the early 20th century. He was not involved in the 1857 revolt.
 
• **Rani Lakshmi Bai,** also known as the Queen of Jhansi, was a prominent figure in the Indian Rebellion of 1857 and led the fight against the British in the region of Jhansi.
